segments.title: 第189章 躲貓貓
segments.content:
Basan Books, Rekindling the Verdant Years!

A little after nine in the evening, Li Luo looked at the single Old Maid card left in his hand, took a deep breath, and silently accepted the fact that he had lost another round.

Having been the first to run out of cards, Yan Zhusheng quietly picked up a lipstick, looked left and right, then glanced at Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu for instructions, her expression seeming to ask, "How should I draw this time?"

Li Luo crossed his arms and closed his eyes as if resigned to his fate.

By now, there was barely a clean spot left on his face.

He had no idea how it had come to this.

When it came to Old Maid, a game of pure luck, he just seemed to be naturally unluckier than everyone else.

It had been just over two hours since they finished dinner. With each round lasting a few minutes on average, they had played twenty or thirty rounds.

Logically, with six people, each person should have lost about four or five times on average.

But he had somehow lost more than ten times, and his face was almost completely covered in red by them.

The only thing that comforted him was that the other girls hadn't completely escaped either. At least everyone's face was marked, so it wasn't a total loss.

Especially when Zhao Rongjun won and the losers were Ying Chanxi and the other two, Li Luo would unceremoniously take the lipstick and do it himself.

Zhao Rongjun was more than happy with this arrangement, dutifully handing over the lipstick with a huge sigh of relief.

This time, it was Yan Zhusheng's turn. Seeing that there was hardly any clean space left on Li Luo's face, she hesitated.

In the end, it was Xu Youyu who came up with an idea. She said with a chuckle, "His eyelids are still pretty clean, aren't they? Look, he's already closed his eyes, so just help him draw an eye on there."

Li Luo: "..."

Hearing Xu Youyu's words, Li Luo's eyelid couldn't help but twitch.

But a bet was a bet. He kept his eyes shut tight, resigned to letting Yan Zhusheng do as she pleased.

"Don't move." Yan Zhusheng held Li Luo's chin with one hand and the lipstick with the other, leaning her face very close as she drew on his eyelid with great concentration.

Beside them, Ying Chanxi stared intently at the distance between the two, her gaze occasionally falling on Yan Zhusheng's fingers holding Li Luo's chin, feeling like she was learning a lot.

"Are you done yet?" Li Luo asked helplessly.

"Almost." Yan Zhusheng frowned. "It's hard to draw on eyelids. I'm afraid I'll poke you if I press too hard."

"So I should thank you for being so merciful?"

"You're welcome."

Yan Zhusheng grew a little impatient with him constantly talking and moving his face. She simply pinched his cheeks, making it impossible for him to speak. "Be quiet."

Now, Li Luo was rendered speechless.

Beside them, Xu Youyu burst out laughing, collapsing onto the sofa in hysterics.

Only Ying Chanxi stared at Yan Zhusheng's hand, her own hands propped on the sofa clenching slightly. "Zhusheng, that's good enough. You don't have to draw it so meticulously."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded, finally stopping. She nodded with some satisfaction.

Li Luo opened his eyes and patted Yan Zhusheng's other hand with a resigned look, signaling for her to let go.

Yan Zhusheng finally realized and let go, freeing his mouth.

But before he could say anything, Xu Youyu urged from the side, "Why did you open your eyes? Hurry and close them, I haven't gotten a good look yet. Let's see how it turned out."

Li Luo: "...Don't you guys take it too far!"

"You talk too much." Ying Chanxi copied the move and pinched his mouth shut with one hand, while covering Li Luo's eyes with the other to carefully admire Yan Zhusheng's artwork.

After being bullied by the three of them in turn, Li Luo was finally set free. He sat back down on the sofa menacingly. "Hurry up! Next round! Just you all wait!"

Unfortunately, the next round had nothing to do with them.

Zhao Rongjun won, and Qiao Xinyan lost.

"Um..." Seeing Qiao Xinyan, who had already accepted her loss and was handing over the lipstick, Zhao Rongjun's hand trembled. He looked at Li Luo for help, attempting to hand over the responsibility again.

But Ying Chanxi had already swiftly inserted herself between them, smiling at him. "Zhao Rongjun, can't you stop letting Li Luo do the drawing all the time? Don't you feel left out?"

"I feel pretty involved..." Zhao Rongjun muttered under his breath. "Besides, you didn't object when I let Li Luo draw earlier..."

"It's been so many times, you should at least draw once." Ying Chanxi pulled Qiao Xinyan to her side, pressing down on her shoulders as she spoke to Zhao Rongjun. "Is our Xinyan that scary? Just draw whatever you want."

Qiao Xinyan had long been aware of Zhao Rongjun's personality—socially anxious around girls—so she joined in with Ying Chanxi's teasing with a grin. "I don't mind, so what are you afraid of?"

Backed into a corner of the sofa by the two girls, Zhao Rongjun trembled, frantically winking at Li Luo, sending out a barrage of S.O.S. signals.

But Li Luo just chuckled, crossing his arms and watching the show from the side. "If she tells you to draw, then just draw. Don't act like you're the one who lost and is being punished."

"I feel like this is my punishment..." Zhao Rongjun's mouth twitched. "How about we let Qiao Xinyan draw on my face instead?"

"A bet is a bet. Don't mess with the rules," Li Luo urged. "Come on, are you a man or not?"

Seeing that even his good buddy wouldn't help him, Zhao Rongjun had no choice. He gritted his teeth, closed his eyes as if resigned to his fate, and with a trembling hand, brought the lipstick toward Qiao Xinyan's face.

"You're going to poke me in the eye." Qiao Xinyan dodged, at a loss whether to laugh or cry. "At least open your eyes and aim a little."

"Ah... sorry, sorry." Zhao Rongjun quickly opened his eyes, but he didn't dare to look at her directly. He had to turn his face to the side, occasionally glancing at her with his peripheral vision to confirm her position before lightly drawing a line on Qiao Xinyan's cheek.

"You really know how to be gentle with the ladies." Ying Chanxi looked at the mark on Qiao Xinyan's face and clicked her tongue twice. "Look at Li Luo, he has no idea what mercy is."

As she spoke, she pointed to the pig's face drawn on her own cheek.

"In a game, there is no distinction between men and women, only winners and losers," Li Luo said with a straight face. "I was showing my respect for you."

As soon as he said that, after the next round of cards ended, Li Luo's other eyelid also had an eye drawn on it.

The artist was none other than Xu Youyu, the one who had suggested it.

However, after this round ended, Xu Youyu said, "Your face is completely covered. Let's play something else. We should wash off the lipstick first."

"Should we take a picture to commemorate this?" Ying Chanxi raised her hand.

Yan Zhusheng nodded repeatedly, while Li Luo rolled his eyes. He was not only dragged into the photo but also made to stand in the center, his face so covered in lipstick that his features were barely recognizable.

After taking a few pictures with Ying Chanxi's Polaroid, Li Luo gathered the cards and asked, "So what's next?"

"Let's play hide-and-seek!" Xu Youyu suggested enthusiastically.

"Hide-and-seek? There isn't really anywhere to hide in this room, is there?" Li Luo glanced around, thinking it sounded boring.

But Xu Youyu pulled out a blindfold from somewhere. "It's not just regular hide-and-seek. The seeker has to wear a blindfold."

"You've got some interesting ideas, huh?"

Xu Youyu couldn't be bothered with him. After shooting him a glare, she continued, "The seeker wears the blindfold and waits in place for thirty seconds. The hiders have to find a spot within that time, and then they can't move from it."

"But the hiders can adjust their posture, as long as one foot stays in place."

"The person who gets caught gets more lipstick drawn on them and takes over as the seeker."

"That sounds fun." Ying Chanxi clapped her hands. "Let's give it a try."

"Fine." Li Luo stood up and patted his pants. "I'll go wash my face first."

Leading Zhao Rongjun into the master bedroom's bathroom, Li Luo spent a long time finally managing to wash all the lipstick off his face.

Even so, he felt as if a faint red layer remained, one that wouldn't wash off no matter how hard he tried.

"How are you able to play games with them so naturally?" Zhao Rongjun sighed from the side. "It feels so tiring."

"You probably have too much of a filter when you think about the opposite sex," Li Luo glanced at him and said. "But in reality, everyone's just a person. Why can you have fun with guys but not with girls? In the end, it's because you see them as too special."

"It's you who's too casual!" Zhao Rongjun argued weakly. "After all, men and women should keep a distance... this... anyway... it's not right to be so casual, is it?"

"You have a point," Li Luo smiled. "But there's a limit to everything. At least, that's not a reason for you to not even dare to draw with a lipstick."

"Well, I was nervous..."

"Stop seeing girls as 'girls.' First, see them as ordinary people," Li Luo said. "They are people, students, your classmates, someone's children, and friends."

"Everyone has many identities, but you care most about the gender distinction."

"But actually, everyone has many other identity tags. Don't deliberately magnify one of them. Just see them normally."

"But I don't expect you to change just because I said a few words. Just be yourself, take it slow."

Li Luo patted Zhao Rongjun's shoulder and offered a smile of encouragement. "At least you did well today. You were able to say a lot more during cards, much more than when we were playing ball this afternoon."

After giving his good friend a pep talk, the two of them walked back to the living room.

Ying Chanxi and the other three had also quickly washed their faces. The six of them gathered in the living room again and set the boundaries for hide-and-seek, confining it to the living room area.

Then, the six of them played rock-paper-scissors to choose the first victim—

"Why do I feel like my luck has been terrible all night?" Li Luo took the blindfold from Xu Youyu with a look of utter exasperation.

"Accept reality, my boy." Xu Youyu said with a grin. "After we hide, you have three minutes. If you don't catch anyone within three minutes, you lose."

"Why wasn't this a rule just now?"

"Just thought of it. Good luck."

"Hah." Li Luo stood in the center of the living room, put on the blindfold, took a deep breath, and suddenly shouted, "Come on! Let's do this!"

"You scared me to death!" Ying Chanxi was startled by his sudden yell and gave him an annoyed kick before quickly finding a place to hide.

Thirty seconds passed quickly.

The other five had all found their spots.

A pre-set alarm on a phone on the coffee table rang, alerting Li Luo that the game had begun.

"Here I come." The blindfolded Li Luo chuckled. The memory palace in his mind began to work, perfectly recreating a one-to-one scale model of the living room in his head.

I can't beat you at Old Maid.

But how could I lose at hide-and-seek?

(End of this chapter)
